_README: This is the ONE place to change business details. Edit, save, then run `node build.js` (Cloudflare Pages does this automatically on every push). Never put API keys or passwords in this file: it is public.

whatsapp._note: Digits only, country code first, no + or spaces. Change this if you get a separate WhatsApp Business number.

email._note: Only the public address is shown on the website. The owner address is kept here for reference and for future back-end notifications.

registeredOffice.notice: Registered office — not a customer service location.

availability.emergencyText: Emergency call-outs available — call to confirm current availability.
availability.generalText: Call, WhatsApp or email and we will confirm availability for your job.

hours._note: Leave confirmed=false until you have decided your hours. When confirmed, set displayText (e.g. 'Monday to Friday 8am–6pm, Saturday 9am–1pm') and fill openingHoursSpecification so search engines can read them.

_showPlaceholdersNote: true = show clearly labelled 'owner to add' boxes for credentials, reviews and the review link. Set to false before launch if you have not filled them in; empty items will then be hidden instead.
_reviewsNote: Add ONLY genuine reviews, copied word for word with permission or from your Google Business Profile. Format: { "author": "First name + initial", "text": "...", "rating": 5, "date": "2026-11-01", "source": "Google" }

aiChat._note: AI_CHAT_ENABLED. Keep false until the secure back end in AI_RECEPTIONIST_PLAN.md is live and tested. When false, no chat code is loaded at all.

analytics._note: Optional. Prefer turning on Web Analytics in the Cloudflare Pages dashboard (no code needed). Only fill this if you use the manual JS snippet. Do NOT add Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or other trackers without a consent mechanism.
